title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-28
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR7-A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Front‑of‑board (FOB) recording delivers brilliant mids, crisp highs and solid bass with crystal‑clear cymbal detail, capturing a high‑energy set highlighted by Jack Straw, Terrapin Station and a soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The FOB tape offers an open, well‑balanced sound with excellent ride‑cymbal definition and a loud, clear PA mix. Musically the show is described as hot and tight from start to finish, featuring standout moments like Jack Straw, Shakedown Street, Terrapin Station and a surprise‑filled Morning Dew. Overall it’s a highly recommended download for Deadheads who value both superb audio fidelity and an energetic performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The review praises both the recording (excellent FOB sound) and the show (high energy, many standout songs), resulting in a rating above average but based on a single detailed source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑board capture with open sound, brilliant mid‑range, clear highs and significant bass response; PA is loud and clear; ride cymbal bell and overall cymbal definition are exceptionally well reproduced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set mixes new and classic material with strong momentum; second set finds the groove, building to a quiet, mesmerized Terrapin Station and ending with high‑spirited encores.

band_member_comments.Drums: Ride cymbal bell and overall cymbal definition are noted as exceptionally clear, a rare achievement with two drummers.
